name: warm-compact
description: Compact a large idle session while its one-hour prompt cache is still warm

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last model request before the session is compacted; keep it a few minutes under the one-hour cache

cutoffMinutes.title: Cutoff minutes
cutoffMinutes.description: A timer that fires later than this many minutes after the last request (the computer slept) skips: the cache is cold already

minTokens.title: Minimum context
minTokens.description: Context size in tokens below which a cold re-read is cheap and the session is left as it is

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's messages and of its instructions to the summary

noteHint.title: Note hint
noteHint.description: Extra text added to the summary instructions, for example what else to keep
